summary: Iteration 109: full defect audit of the customer depot and the admin area (preview only, nothing deployed). Writes were made only on test_eur_qa@example.com. BACKEND: new pytest file test_depot_admin_audit_iter109.py, 61 tests: 55 pass, 6 fail (1 of the 6 was a test mistake and has been fixed). WHAT WORKS: order validation for 0, negative, NaN, abc, 1.5, 1e3, blank, float, Infinity and 1e40 (422/400); market orders rejected; extra fields rejected; German messages for not enough cash or shares; a pending buy reserves cash and cancelling releases it; a second buy over the remaining cash is rejected; pending sells are counted against holdings; the same idempotency key sent twice and 5 times in parallel creates 1 order; cancelling twice is idempotent; cancelling an executed order gives 409. IDOR: cancelling another user's order gives 404, and user_id query params are ignored. Customer gets 403 on all 183 /api/admin/* operations, and unauthenticated requests get 401 on all of them. No password_hash, tokens or _id in customer or admin responses. CSRF with a foreign Origin gives 403 for customer and admin writes. CORS preflight from a foreign origin is denied. Login limit: 5x401 then 429, IP counters cleared afterwards. Passwords are bcrypt $2b$. HTTP redirects to HTTPS. FAILURES: (1) a sell of a position the admin created gives 500, because the quantity is stored as Decimal128; (2) a huge quantity gives 500 (decimal.InvalidOperation); (3) the API and the frontend send no security headers; (4) /api/portfolio/quotes has no limit on the number of symbols (150 unknown symbols gave 502 after 60 s). FRONTEND: customer login; search palette 'Microsoft' -> MSFT; AAPL stock detail; a double-click on submit sent exactly 1 POST (201) and buying power dropped from 2.001,00 to 2.000,00; watchlist add, persist after reload, remove all work; cancel on /dashboard/auftraege worked (200) and the row turned Storniert. The UI cost estimate is off by 1-2 cents from what the server reserves. Admin pages /admin/users, /admin/stock-orders, /admin/user-positions, /admin/stocks and /admin/ipo-requests load with no errors and show correct data.

critical.issue: HIGH. Customers cannot sell positions the admin created. POST /api/admin/customers/{uid}/stock-positions (admin_customer_assets.py:243) stores quantity as Decimal128(str(float)), e.g. 2.0. create_order then calls int(pos.get('quantity')) (portfolio.py:1028), which raises TypeError: int() argument ... not 'Decimal128', and the response is 500 Internal Server Error. Repro: admin POST stock-positions {symbol:MSFT, quantity:2, avg_cost:300} for test_eur_qa, then the customer POSTs a sell of 1 MSFT limit 9999 -> 500 (traceback in backend.err.log). The same int(Decimal128) pattern is in order_execution_service.py:314 (sell check), :807 (buy merge) and :869 (sell decrement), so an admin execute on these positions would also crash. Existing data already affected: position 6a9ed866fcded304797dbf60 (SAP, demo.kunde@kapital-direkt24.de). Fix: in add_stock, store the quantity as an int and reject fractional values (StockIn.quantity: int, gt=0). Add a helper _qty(v) that handles Decimal128, float and str, and use it everywhere int(quantity) is used. Migrate existing Decimal128 quantities to int.

MEDIUM. A huge quantity causes a 500 with no German message. quantity='9'*30 (buy or sell) -> 500 Internal Server Error. Cause: gross = (limit_price*qty).quantize(...) at portfolio.py:1011 raises decimal.InvalidOperation (more than 28 digits) before the cash or shares check. Fix: cap qty (e.g. 1 <= qty <= 10_000_000) right after int() and reject anything else with 422 'Stückzahl ungültig'. Also cap limit_price (e.g. <= 1_000_000) and catch InvalidOperation.

minor.issue: MEDIUM (DoS / upstream rate limits). No cap on the symbols CSV. 150 or 80 unknown symbols -> the backend fetches each one from yfinance and the ingress returns 502 after 60 s. Any logged-in customer can trigger this repeatedly, which risks Yahoo throttling the server IP for all users. Fix: limit to about 50 symbols (422 if more) and apply _SYMBOL_RE to each one.

MEDIUM. No Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy (frame-ancestors) headers, on either /api/* or the SPA. The SPA can be framed (clickjacking). Fix: add a FastAPI middleware that sets HSTS (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains), nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY and a CSP with frame-ancestors 'none'. The same headers are needed for the frontend in production hosting.

Accepts fractional quantity (0.5 was saved and shown to the customer). Orders only allow whole shares, so such positions cannot be sold fully and break int() math. symbol is only whitespace-stripped (max 32 characters, any characters) and is not checked against _SYMBOL_RE. Fix: integer quantity and the same symbol regex as orders.

If an existing user has an ADMIN_EXTRAS email, the account is promoted to admin and its existing password is kept. Anyone who self-registers that email before the first deploy seed (fresh prod DB) becomes admin with their own password. Fix: never promote an existing non-admin. Log a warning and require a manual step instead.

Slow on cold call: 1.31 s, then 0.87 s, then 0.12 s warm. admin_customer_overview.py:207 runs a $group aggregate over whole collections with no $match on user ids. Fix: add {$match:{user_id:{$in:ids}}} and indexes.

Missing or extra fields return the raw English Pydantic array (e.g. 'Field required', 'Extra inputs are not permitted'), not German text. Many server messages are German but technical ('quantity muss > 0 sein', 'ungültige order_id'). Fix: add a RequestValidationError handler that returns a German detail string.
Info: admin debit adjustments are blocked by design (403), so a test deposit cannot be reversed through the API. test_eur_qa now has +1.00 EUR (balance 2001.00) from this run.

ui_bugs.issue: The UI estimate does not match what the server reserves. The limit field is prefilled with the full-precision quote (e.g. '309.8232'). The UI computes 3 x 309.8232 = 929,47 EUR, but the payload sends limit_price '309.82', so the server reserves 929,46. A typed 1.005 x 3 shows 3,02 EUR while the server reserves 3,00. Fix: round the limit price to 2 decimals on prefill and on blur, and compute estGross from the same rounded value that is sent.
Uses step='0.0001', which suggests fractional shares, but orders are whole numbers only. Use step='1' and min='1'.
Picking MSFT goes to /aktien/MSFT (public layout), not /dashboard/aktien/MSFT, so the customer leaves the dashboard shell. The palette only searches 60 featured stocks on the client side.

integration_issues.issue: Duplicate calls in the dev build (StrictMode doubles effects): /api/portfolio/cash x4, /api/portfolio/orders x4, /api/news-markte/market/overview x4, /api/content/news/list x4, and the other depot reads x2, out of 39 API calls in total. Even without StrictMode, cash and orders are fetched twice (DashboardDataContext plus another consumer). Quotes are fine: 1 on first load, and about every 5.4 s over 60 s (11 calls, no duplicates). POST /api/alerts/check fires on every refreshAll (2x per page load).

Every admin page also loads the customer-only endpoints /api/portfolio/orders, /api/portfolio/cash and /api/stock-notifications (2x each) for the admin account, plus /api/auth/me 2x and /api/admin/notifications/counts 2x. /admin/stock-orders took 5.4 s to networkidle because /api/portfolio/quotes took 3.3 to 3.6 s (cold fetch of BADSYM/STALEONLY), and it was called twice.

Open and completed orders share one table, with no split or filter into Offen and Abgeschlossen. The list comes from GET /api/portfolio/orders?limit=50, so pending orders older than the 50 newest would disappear from the page. StockDetail uses limit=200 for pendingSellQty.

issues: The same unrealized P/L of +305,20 EUR is shown as +9,57 % on /dashboard (base 3.190 EUR invested incl. bonds) and as +14,46 % on /mein-depot (base about 2.110 EUR, priced stocks plus IPO). Use one denominator or label the bases clearly.
/mein-depot shows 'Depotwert 7.299,16 EUR' in the hero and 'Gesamtdepotwert 3.495,20 EUR' in the Depotübersicht directly below. These are confusing labels for different numbers.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the int(Decimal128) crash. Make admin_customer_assets.add_stock store an integer quantity (reject fractional values), add a safe _qty() helper in portfolio.py:1028 and order_execution_service.py:314/807/869, and migrate existing Decimal128 quantities (e.g. SAP 6a9ed866fcded304797dbf60).
MEDIUM: Cap quantity (1..10_000_000) and limit_price in create_order and coupon peek, and catch decimal.InvalidOperation -> 422 in German.
MEDIUM: Cap /api/portfolio/quotes at about 50 symbols and validate each with _SYMBOL_RE.
MEDIUM: Add security headers middleware (HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, CSP frame-ancestors) to the API and the SPA hosting.
MEDIUM: In StockDetail, round the limit price to 2 decimals (prefill and input) and compute estGross/estNet from the same rounded value that is sent.
LOW: ADMIN_EXTRAS must not promote existing non-admin accounts.
LOW: Remove the duplicate cash and orders fetches and the customer-only fetches in the admin shell. Add $match to the overview aggregates.
LOW: Add a German RequestValidationError handler, set the quantity input to step=1, keep palette navigation inside /dashboard/aktien/:symbol, and use one consistent P/L % base.
critical_code_review_comments: portfolio.py _order_locks is a per-process asyncio.Lock. With more than one worker or pod, the buy-cash check (get_cash_summary, then insert) is not atomic, so two parallel buys with different idempotency keys could both pass and overspend. The unique (user_id, idempotency_key) index only protects identical keys. Use an atomic Mongo reservation (findOneAndUpdate on a per-user cash doc) or a distributed lock.
Sell availability takes find_one on stock_positions matching user_id as either ObjectId or str. If both legacy and new docs exist, only one is counted. The is_active flag is not checked.
portfolio.py is 1608 lines and server.py is 5823 lines, well over the 700-line guideline.
admin delete_stock deletes by position_id with no user scoping and no audit log entry. Admin-only, but consider an audit trail like position_adjustments.

rca of the issue: Decimal128 crash: admin_customer_assets.add_stock writes Decimal128(str(float)) quantities, while the customer order flow and the execution service assume int and call int() directly. bson Decimal128 has no __int__, so int() raises TypeError -> 500. Repro and fix are in backend_issues.critical[0]. Huge quantity: Decimal context precision is 28, and quantize of qty*price with more than 28 digits raises InvalidOperation, which nothing catches.
